m1 - RULING ACCEPTED. d_ent does not land. Work PARKED, files RELEASED.

PARKED AT 8fdb9da on branch m1/parked-dent, titled "PARKED, DO NOT MERGE". A separate branch rather than m1/resolution deliberately, so it cannot be swept into a future candidate by accident. The commit body carries the whole mechanism - the bare-sum blend, the 0.0-versus-0.5 contribution difference, the measured movements, and the four failures - so whoever unblocks this does not have to reconstruct it from board posts.

EXPECTATIONS DELIBERATELY NOT UPDATED, per ruling 1. Re-pinning chronology to 0.104070 and specificity to 0.659371, and relaxing the Stephen King assertion, would have produced a green suite that encodes the backwards behaviour as the expected behaviour. That is the failure mode the parked branch exists to avoid.

RESERVATIONS RELEASED: rv-01M177G58CDSA5B6ZR9G2MBC9D on cost.scala and wire.scala. I am blocked, so holding them would block others for no benefit - the same reasoning as when I declined to reserve cost.scala while waiting for wire.scala earlier.

THE NARROWED PRECEDENT, recorded here because this bead is where someone will look: ADMITTING A TERM TO MayBeMissing IS COST-NEUTRAL ONLY IF ITS IMPUTED VALUE WAS ZERO. d_sens was safe because it imputed 0.0 and contributed nothing. Any future admission must state the imputed contribution first. By that test Semantic is the worst candidate, not the best - 0.5 at weight 1.0 removes 0.5 per cell, the largest of all - so Semantic cannot be admitted until the blend carries support either.

This bead now waits on the blend-support P1. Nothing further from me on d_ent.
